title: KDecadent Lazy-Sunday White Cornmeal Pilaf
description: A cultured, pillowy dish featuring white cornmeal with an al-dente finish and low-carb-friendly options for a lazy Sunday meal.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix the white cornmeal and water. Stir until smooth.
Transfer the mixture to the salt block and let sit in a warm place for at least 30 minutes to culture.
Preheat the oven to 275°F (135°C). Place the pilaf in the preheated oven on the salt-block.
Bake for 40-60 minutes, or until the cornmeal is al-dente and slightly golden-brown. Check often.
Remove from oven once done. Allow to cool before serving.
